summary: The diff addresses both REQ-1 (fix Save Profile error) and REQ-2 (fix banner button functionality). The backend adds a bannerImage field to UserProfileInput and a migration module. The frontend ProfilePage is updated to include bannerImage in all saveCallerUserProfile calls, initialize banner state from profile on load, and immediately persist banner changes. REQ-1's save logic fix and REQ-2's banner upload/persist flow both appear implemented. All core acceptance criteria are addressed.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added to handle schema migration from old profile shape (without bannerImage) to new shape (with bannerImage).
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked to fix the Save Profile error and banner button functionality. A formal migration module was not explicitly requested, though it may be a necessary implementation detail.
